title: Airtime today resets at the member local midnight
detail: Line 352 uses the UTC day, so it resets near 5pm Pacific. Use lib/on-air/dispatch-day.ts the way Dispatches do. Closed: Airtime today floors at the community (Pacific) midnight via startOfDispatchDay.
